query: Which DPIA elements and lawful bases must be documented for GDPR-compliant community-archive research with potential cross-border cloud storage?

response.query: Which DPIA elements and lawful bases must be documented for GDPR-compliant community-archive research with potential cross-border cloud storage?
response.answer: For GDPR-compliant community-archive research with cross-border cloud storage, document DPIA elements including data processing purposes, data subject rights, and risk assessments. Use lawful bases such as consent or legitimate interest.

results.title: The California Effect - PEN America
results.content: In the past two decades, California’s online security laws requiring notification for data breaches have served as models for measures passed in nearly half of U.S. states.29)Conor Dougherty, “Can the ‘California Effect’ Survive in a Hyperpartisan America?” The New York Times, May 30, 2023, nytimes.com/2023/05/30/magazine/california-effect.html Many of California’s most pioneering policies take aim at the way technology intersects with other industries like education and journalism, from dictating how much information tech companies can retain about students, to mandating that platforms pay for local news content.30)California SB 1177 Privacy – students (Student Online Personal Information Protection Act): ; California AB 886 (California Journalism Preservation Act):.
